request.summary: Continuar mejoras evolutivas de plantilla y detección OMR/QR, haciendo ejecutable y ligero el fallback OCR del pie.

objective: Corregir la carga runtime de Tesseract.js, evitar su inclusión en el chunk general y mostrar procedencia OCR con claridad, preservando el cierre ante ambigüedad.
scope: Resolver Tesseract.js mediante import diferido estático compatible con Vite
Aislar Tesseract en un chunk bajo demanda
Actualizar la UI para distinguir QR de identidad recuperada por OCR
Validar focalmente sin modificar calificaciones ni ejecutar benchmark fotográfico
constraints: No agregar paquetes npm ni descargar modelos OCR
Mantener worker, WASM y disponibilidad de modelos como pendiente explícito

actions.summary: Eliminado import bare con @vite-ignore en los dos consumidores OCR; Vite genera vendor-ocr dinámico. La UI etiqueta la identidad OCR separada de QR validado.
SPEC-062 actualizada a 1.24.11 con requisitos de bundling y límites de recursos offline; se registra la evidencia del build temporal.

decisions: Use import('tesseract.js') in a shared async loader so the bundler resolves the package; isolate tesseract.js modules into vendor-ocr.
Do not claim offline OCR: worker and language/core assets still use package defaults/caches, and traineddata is not present in the repository node_modules.
Do not rerun the 48-photo backend benchmark as evidence for frontend OCR; its current baseline has no key or observed labels and does not execute Tesseract OCR.
assumptions: Existing Tesseract.js dependency remains the selected OCR engine pending real-photo calibration.
The QR/footer confidence threshold of 75/100 remains provisional.
risks: No real-photo OCR run: the model may require network on first use; failure is caught and requests manual identity.
Full local packaging of worker, WASM and language data may add tens of MB; no user approval to vendor these assets has been obtained.

The last full OMR report is 48 pages, 31/48 exact direct QR, one additional geometry rescue, 15 QR misses, 255/360 determined responses and no independent key/observed answer labels; it is not an accuracy claim.
nextStep: Request approval for an offline resource packaging option and calibrate OCR footer recovery against QR-missed real photos; rerun full OMR photo coverage only after detector changes and use independent labels before claiming answer accuracy.
